description: This file contains implementation code for PHY patching operations specific to RTL8261N network PHY hardware. It includes functions for translating patch operations, applying patches to hardware, processing patch sequences, and a specific patch configuration array for RTL826X hardware. The file also manages external dependencies and functions related to hardware patch management.

methods.name: uint8 phy_patch_op_translate(uint8 patch_mode,uint8 patch_op,uint8 compare_op)
methods.description: Translates the patch operation code based on patch mode and compare operation, handling special comparison cases.

methods.name: int32 phy_patch_op(rt_phy_patch_db_t * pPhy_patchDb,uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_op,uint16 portmask,uint16 pagemmd,uint16 addr,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint16 data,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Executes a hardware patch operation with specified parameters and updates the patch database.

methods.name: int32 _phy_patch_process(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,rtk_hwpatch_t * pPatch,int32 size,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Processes an array of patch entries, applying each patch and handling errors or failures during the process.

methods.name: int32 phy_patch(uint32 unit,rtk_port_t port,uint8 portOffset,uint8 patch_mode)
methods.description: Main function to apply initial patch data to PHY hardware by executing a sequence of patch entries and optional RTL-specific configuration patches.
